derives_from: docs/fable5-app-integration-readiness/mock-harness/ scenario canon (57 scenarios: MR, RF, MC, GG, MA, ME families)
cardinal_rule: every fixture is SYNTHETIC: invented section numbers in reserved ranges, citation_display strings prefixed 'SYNTHETIC', and no text copied from any real statute, rule, policy, or the generated corpus under data/ingestion-expanded/

synthetic_namespace.tca_like: TCA 36-9-9xx and 37-9-9xx reserved fake ranges (no real sections exist there)
synthetic_namespace.tre_like: TRE Rule 9xx fake range, answer_scope limited_evidentiary_procedural
synthetic_namespace.body_stub: fixture 'excerpt' fields, where a scenario requires one, contain lorem-style SYNTHETIC sentences only

fixture_groups.serves: MR-01..MR-03, MC-01..MC-03, MA-01..MA-02, happy-path answer envelopes
MR-04..MR-05, RF-05, restricted_display_only refusals; envelopes expose gate flags, never content
MR-06, RF-12 (DCS guardrail_reference_only), RF-13 (TRE limited scope), GQ-4 mix validation
MR-08, RF-11, GQ-2 as-of-date refusals; effectivity windows straddling the test as_of_date
MC-04..MC-05 parent/child clamp cases; parent chunk plus claimed-subsection mismatch
MR-07, RF-01 no_authority_support; queries mapped to zero envelopes
MR-09 timeout, MR-10 malformed, MA-06..MA-07 sink rejection, GG-11 pattern-load failure; reserved SYNTHETIC trigger query strings

shape.alias_entry: normalized_alias, authority_key, family_code, answer_scope, gate flags, effectivity window
shape.chunk_entry: chunk_ref, authority_key, citation_display (SYNTHETIC-prefixed), answer_scope, verification_level, gate flags, optional synthetic excerpt
shape.sync_rule: scenario ids referenced by fixtures must exist in the synced scenario copies under app/src/__tests__/qa-research/scenarios/; scenario-sync.test.ts enforces sha256 equality with the F5-02 canon

maintenance: fixtures change only alongside a scenario-canon change in a reviewed commit; fixture_manifest_hash recomputed and surfaced through healthProbe so drift is visible in the UI target chip
